title: 第一卷 第15章 火力覆盖
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
海河之上，雾气未散。

    顺昌号像一座钢铁堡垒，劈开浑浊的江水，轰鸣着逼近。

    船头挂着青帮的青龙旗，迎风招展，嚣张至极。

    甲板上，几十号青帮精锐手持砍刀、火铳，一字排开。

    为首一人，身穿黑色练功服，双手负后，正是铁掌李三爷。

    他看着远处拦截的海河帮镇涛号，嘴角露出一丝不屑。

    “赵海柱是疯了吗？”

    “派这种破船来拦路？”

    “也不看看自己几斤几两。”

    身旁的小弟谄媚道：“三爷，估计是来送过路费的吧？听说海河帮最近日子不好过。”

    李三爷冷哼一声：“算他们识相。待会儿让他们把今年的例钱加倍，少一个子儿，老子就把这船扣下！”

    两船距离迅速拉近。

    五百米。

    三百米。

    一百米。

    顺昌号上的青帮众已经能看清对面甲板上的情况。

    然而，看清之后，李三爷的笑容凝固了。

    对面那艘破船的甲板上，没有跪地求饶的怂包。

    只有一排黑洞洞的枪口。

    以及站在最前面，那个扛着一根铁棍的年轻人。

    陆川站在船头，江风吹得他衣摆猎猎作响。

    他看着越来越近的顺昌号，像是看着一具移动的尸体。

    “陆......陆爷，太近了！”

    吴先生抱着那挺轻机枪，手心里全是汗，声音都在抖，“这要是打起来，咱们也得完蛋啊！”

    “怕什么？”

    陆川头也没回，淡淡道，“狭路相逢，火力猛者胜。”

    “记住我教你的口诀了吗？”

    吴先生咽了口唾沫：“记......记住了。”

    “那还等什么？”

    陆川猛地将手中的精铁长棍往甲板上一杵，一把躲过吴先生手里的轻机枪。

    “弟兄们，开火！”

    随着陆川一声令下。

    “哒哒哒哒哒哒——！！！”

    吴先生闭着眼，根本就不敢看接下来要发生的恐怖一幕。

    轻机枪喷吐出半米长的火舌。

    紧接着，另一挺轻机枪和二十把驳壳枪也响了。

    还有那几个胆子大的汉子，拉开了手榴弹的拉环，闭着眼就往对面扔。

    这一刻，海河之上，硝烟弥漫。

    这不是江湖斗殴。

    这是屠杀！

    顺昌号上，李三爷脸上的轻蔑还没褪去，就被密集的弹雨撕成了碎片。

    “噗噗噗！”

    站在最前排的几个青帮精锐连惨叫都没发出来，胸口就被打成了筛子，血雾在空中炸开，整个人像破布袋一样向后倒去。

    “敌袭！有枪！”

    “妈的，是机枪！快躲！”

    刚才还威风凛凛的青帮众瞬间乱作一团。

    他们手里拿的是砍刀和老式火铳，射速慢，威力小。

    对面却是连发的驳壳枪和轻机枪，这怎么打？

    “轰！轰！”
content_en:
Above the Haihe River, the fog has not dispersed.

    The Shunchang was like a steel fortress, splitting the turbid river water and approaching with a roar.

    The green dragon flag of the Qing Gang hung on the bow of the ship, fluttering in the wind, extremely arrogant.

    On the deck, dozens of elite Qing Gang men were lined up in a row, holding machetes and firecrackers.

    The leader, wearing black training uniforms with his hands behind his back, was none other than Iron Palm Master Li Sanye.

    He looked at the Haihe Gang's Zhentao intercepted in the distance with a trace of disdain on his lips.

    "Is Zhao Haizhu crazy?"

    "Send this broken ship to block the road?"

    "I don't even look at how much I weigh."

    The younger brother next to him said flatteringly: "Third Master, I guess you are here to deliver tolls, right? I heard that the Haihe Gang has been having a hard time recently."

    Mr. Li Sanye snorted coldly: "They know what they're doing. I'll ask them to double this year's payment later. If it's a penny less, I'll seize the boat!"

    The distance between the two ships quickly narrowed.

    Five hundred meters.

    Three hundred meters.

    One hundred meters.

    The Qinggang members on board the Shunchang could already clearly see the situation on the opposite deck.

    However, after seeing it clearly, Li Sanye's smile froze.

    On the deck of the broken ship opposite, there was no coward kneeling down to beg for mercy.

    There was only a row of black muzzles.

    And standing at the front, the young man carrying an iron rod.

    Lu Chuan stood at the bow of the boat, his clothes rustling in the river wind.

    He looked at the Shunchang getting closer and closer, as if looking at a moving corpse.

    "Lu... Master Lu, you're too close!"

    Mr. Wu was holding the light machine gun, his palms were full of sweat, and his voice was trembling, "If this starts a fight, we will be finished!"

    "What are you afraid of?"

    Lu Chuan didn't even look back and said calmly, "When we meet on a narrow road, the one with the strongest firepower will win."

    "Do you remember the formula I taught you?"

    Mr. Wu swallowed: "Remember...remember."

    "Then what are you waiting for?"

    Lu Chuan slammed the fine iron long stick in his hand onto the deck, dodging the light machine gun in Mr. Wu's hand.

    "Brothers, fire!"

    Following Lu Chuan's order.

    "Da da da da da da-!!!"

    Mr. Wu closed his eyes, not daring to look at the horrific scene that was about to happen next.

    The light machine gun spit out a tongue of flame half a meter long.

    Immediately afterwards, another light machine gun and twenty shell guns also rang.

    There were also those brave men who pulled the tabs of grenades and threw them to the opposite side with their eyes closed.

    At this moment, the sea and river were filled with smoke.

    This is not a quarrelling.

    This is massacre!

    On the Shunchang, before the contempt on Li Sanye's face faded away, he was torn into pieces by a dense rain of bullets.

    "Puff puff puff!"

    The few elites of the Green Gang standing in the front row didn't even scream, their chests were beaten into sieves, blood mist exploded in the air, and their whole bodies fell backwards like rag bags.

    "Enemy attack! There are guns!"

    "Damn it, it's a machine gun! Hurry and hide!"

    The Green Gang members, who had been so majestic just now, were instantly in chaos.

    What they hold in their hands are machetes and old-fashioned firecrackers, which have a slow rate of fire and low power.

    On the opposite side are continuous shell guns and light machine guns. How can we fight this?

    "Boom! Boom!"
